intro.text: A young guide recommended by his uncle, a Dosha-Har'Ken merchant, to lead Duchess Khrissalla's party to Kezare.
A young Kerztian guide hired by Duchess Khrissalla's party, who is shot dead by Flennid.

items.text: Daazk met Khriss's party as they bargained with his uncle, the one merchant in Dosha-Har'Ken who had learned Dynastic and outfitted Darkside travellers, and the uncle put him forward as their guide to Kezare.
Crossing the Kerla, he tried to show Khriss where dorim vines could be found, but his Dynastic was too poor to make it clear; she took it for wasted water and had him lead them on to Mount KraeDa.

At the Diem's tents they found the sand masters massacred. Shown a sash, Daazk panicked and fled crying out the Kerztian word for sand masters, and Flennid, thinking he was summoning an ambush, shot him in the back.

appearance.text: A cheerful young Kerztian with warm brown skin, not yet in a DaiKeen and so wearing no symbol; he dresses in a white kaffiyeh, yellow shirt, mauve robes and tan vest.
